value.rationale: The motivating 2023 theorem obtains only an unknown positive zero-free radius; an explicit uniform radius 2 for all inner H4 data turns an existence result into a calculable exclusion region. The first-jet reduction allows two distinct inner functions with identical initial Taylor jets to share the same nonlinear optimal polynomial and supplies a finite-dimensional exact procedure. The claim is not a trivial renaming, an arbitrary slice or an experimental observation; it is an all-inner-function theorem. Its radius may be improved in future.
